title: latency-smoothing-fallback-circuit-hermeticization-and-soft-shed-safeguard
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: we observed intermittent regional latency cliffs that tripped coarse-grained circuit breakers and caused cascading failovers. This PR introduces a more hermetic circuit state machine and a lightweight latency-smoothing fallback that lets a region degrade gracefully instead of failing hard. Goals: 1) Avoid noisy global failovers from transient latency spikes; 2) Provide bounded degradation (soft-shed) for long-tail requests while keeping critical tenants served; 3) Make the circuit state transitions auditable and replayable for post-incident debugging. What changed: - runtime/circuit: implement hermeticized circuit state with explicit epoched snapshots and fenced transitions to prevent cross-epoch state bleed; adds safe rejoin handshake to avoid rapid flip-flop. - runtime/shedder: add a latency-smoothing estimator (EWMA with volatility clamp) used to trigger soft-shed windows instead of instant trips. - runtime/tenant_priority: introduce tenant scoring clamp (prevents low-priority tenants from starving during prolonged soft-shed). - telemetry: emit slo_event.v1 for soft-shed start/stop and circuit-epoch-change for audit. - helm: provide a feature-flagged toggle (LATENCY_SMOOTHING_ENABLED) and rollout knobs (soft_shed_max_pct, tenant_clamp_threshold). - tests: integration and e2e tests that simulate regional tail spikes, verify no cross-region eviction, and assert telemetry correctness. Rollout plan: behind feature flag; staged rollout to canary -> 25% -> 100% with telemetry gates (no more than 1.5x increase in error surfaces for top-10 tenants, and SLO hit rate within configured tolerances). Hotfix note: includes a small race fix for kv-drain observed during prior incident where a rejoin and kv-delta applied concurrently could lose ephemeral leases. Backwards compatibility: state snapshots are forward-compatible; feature disabled by default. Related tickets: Linear ENG-2897, ENG-3012, support SUP-782 when customers saw regional rejoin storms. Testing: unit tests for state transitions, property tests for rejoin handshake; integration tests in tests/integration/regional-failover_test.go. Monitoring: new dashboards added (Telemetry -> Soft Shed Events) and an alert that fires if soft_shed enters >10% of requests for 5m across a region. CI: initial run showed a flaky integration test (replay harness timing) which was fixed by introducing deterministic clocks. See commits and CI logs below.

changes_summary: Implemented new circuit state with epoch fencing, introduced latency EWMA-based smoother, tenant clamp to limit unfair eviction, telemetry/metrics + feature flag and helm values, unit/integration tests, and a small kv-drain race hotfix.
review_conversation: Marco Liang (2026-02-13): Please add a short diagram or sequence in docs showing the rejoin handshake. Concern: will the epoch snapshots increase memory usage for very large tenant counts?

Aisha Patel (2026-02-13): Added docs/running/soft-degradation.md with sequence diagrams and notes. Memory impact is bounded by snapshot window (configurable, default 3 epochs) and we use delta compression for tenant state; added benchmarking numbers to the doc.

Sofia Ramirez (2026-02-14): Tests look good. One nit: telemetry event slo_event.v1 should include region and epoch_id fields for easier correlation. Also can we include a metric for 'soft_shed_duration_ms' aggregated per-tenant?
Aisha Patel (2026-02-14): I added region and epoch_id to the proto and exported soft_shed_duration_ms. Updated integration asserts to match the new schema.

Jonas Bauer (requested changes 2026-02-15): The rejoin handshake seems susceptible to a race with kv-delta replay — I reproduced a small window where ephemeral leases were dropped. Please add a guard and a test that replays concurrent delta+rejoin.
Aisha Patel (2026-02-16): Added guard in circuit_state.go and a targeted integration test that reproduces the race; test was flaky initially, fixed by deterministic clock harness. PTAL.
Marco Liang (approved 2026-02-17): Approving after validating telemetry and mem impact on a 10k tenant local sim. CI green.
Sofia Ramirez (approved 2026-02-17): LGTM. Verified alert thresholds and dashboards render as expected.
ci_details: CI initially failed on tests/integration/regional-failover_test.go due to non-deterministic clock; fix applied in commit f6b8d0e and subsequent run passed all jobs (unit/integration/e2e/lint).
release_notes:
- Add latency-smoothing fallback to reduce hard regional failovers.
- Hermetic circuit state machine with epoched snapshots and safe rejoin handshake.
- Tenant priority clamp to protect higher-tier tenants during soft-shed.
- Feature flag LATENCY_SMOOTHING_ENABLED; disabled by default.
- Hotfix: kv-drain rejoin race addressed.
monitoring_and_rollout: Staged rollout: canary -> 25% -> 100%. Telemetry gates: monitor slo_event.v1 rate and SLO hit rate. New dashboards and alerting configured; rollback criteria documented in docs/running/soft-degradation.md.
incident_reference: This change addresses behaviors observed during incident SUP-782 where regional rejoin storms caused cross-region eviction cascades.
notes_for_ops: If enabling feature flag, ramp slowly and validate 'soft_shed_duration_ms' and 'slo_event.v1' counts. If unexpected spikes in soft_shed (>10% requests for 5m), rollback the flag and open a postmortem.
